subject: shiny-server command line options and help

messages.author: b0b89f2bcaabb36a
messages.subject: shiny-server command line options and help
parts:
I'd like to run multiple concurrent instances of shiny-server with different config files so I'd like to add a command line option to specify the config file.  In looking for how I might code this I see that the existing options are not clearly documented.

First a comment/request:  it would be good to provide documentation and/or a --help option for shiny-server

Second, I might be interested in contributing an option to specify a config file, but it is hard to know where to start with the existing documentation (and wrapper/driver setup).  Where would be the appropriate place to start adding code to fit in with ongoing management of the project.

Gareth
